_README: TAJIK DRAFT — NOT A CATALOGUE, AND NOT MERGEABLE AS ONE.
This file lives outside ui/src/core/i18n/ on purpose: `tg` is not in
LAUNCH_LOCALES and must not be added until a native reviewer has signed
this file. Adding it early fails the CI completeness gate on every empty
key, and a red suite is exactly the pressure that gets unreviewed
`tg` slots are EMPTY by design. Nothing here was machine-translated:
1187 keys of unreviewed Tajik is the artifact E3 §E3.3 warns about, and a
reviewer would have to check every line against the English regardless.
`glossary_hold` marks trucking jargon that STAYS ENGLISH inside Tajik text
(design-prd §12.3). 'detention' rendered as a Tajik word for imprisonment
is not a typo, it is a claim about what this product does.
`icu_placeholders` must survive translation exactly, including the braces.
Full ICU messages only — never concatenate fragments (§12.5).

admin.acct.admin_confirm.en: This gives them every power in this console, including granting it to others.

admin.acct.no_delete.en: Accounts are never deleted — they reference money, claims and evidence.

admin.fac.provenance.en: Your edit is added as an admin source — it never erases what a feed recorded.

admin.flag.confirm_body.en: This switches off a whole module for every driver.

admin.imp.writes.en: Anything you change is recorded as you, not them.

admin.vendor.halal_hint.en: Halal sourcing — write "none" if they make no claim

audit.none.en: No missed pay — your settlement matches your evidence.

audit.review.en: Review with your carrier. This isn't legal advice.

auth.authority_desc.leased.en: You own the truck but run under a carrier's authority.

auth.authority_desc.own_mc.en: You have your own MC# — you bill brokers directly.

auth.error_taken.en: That email already has an account. Log in instead.

auth.tagline.en: Parking, fuel, and getting paid — one app.

authority.error.en: We couldn't confirm that number. Check it and try again.

authority.hint.en: Confirm your authority with a free FMCSA lookup — it strengthens your detention claims.

booking.confirmation.en: Your spot is reserved. Show this on arrival.

calc.basis_mpg_default.en: Fuel figured at {mpg} mpg — ours, not yours. Set it under More.

calc.basis_no_fuel.en: No network fuel on this route, so fuel is not in this figure.

calc.basis_no_stops.en: No tracked stops at this receiver yet, so detention is not in this figure.

calc.basis_recovery.en: Assumes you recover none of the detention.

claim.doc_note.en: Export the PDF or share a link from the evidence record.

claim.exported_hint.en: Company driver — the evidence pack goes to your carrier to collect.

claim.none.en: No claim for this stop yet.

claim.owed_hint.en: Own authority — the broker is invoiced in your name.

claim.pack_blocked.en: Evidence check failed — the pack was not sent

claim.pack_blocked_hint.en: The evidence chain for this stop did not verify. Nothing was sent to the broker.

cond.driving.en: Pull over to photograph the load. Your progress is saved.

corridor.no_heading.en: Waiting for your direction of travel.

docs.arch_blocked.en: A current one is already in your wallet. Remove that one first to bring this back.

docs.arch_empty.en: Nothing is archived yet. Documents you remove, and credentials replaced by a newer one, stay here.

docs.arch_hint.en: Nothing here is deleted. Tap any document to open it.

docs.cap_expiry_hint.en: We warn you 30, 14 and 3 days before.

docs.cap_lost.en: Couldn't save on your phone. Take the photo again.

docs.cap_offline.en: Saves to your phone if you have no signal.

docs.cap_queued.en: Saved on your phone. Syncs when you have signal.

docs.cap_replaced_done.en: The previous one was archived, not deleted.

docs.cap_replaces.en: You already have one of these. Saving replaces it — the old one stays in your records.

docs.empty.en: Your CDL, medical card, insurance and permits live here, ready for a roadside inspection even with no signal. They appear as they are added to your account.

docs.rm_body.en: It leaves your wallet and stops expiry reminders. Nothing is deleted — you can restore it any time from Archived.

docs.view_edit_hint.en: Corrects the date only. To replace the document itself, add a new one.

docs.view_failed.en: Could not open this one. It is still saved.

docs.view_hint.en: Tap any document to show it.

email.domain_dot.en: The domain needs a dot — like acme.com.

email.needs_both.en: An email address needs a name and a domain.

email.no_spaces.en: An email address can't contain spaces.

email.one_at.en: An email address needs exactly one @.

equipment.vin_error.en: That VIN doesn't look right — check the 17 characters.

evidence.export_failed.en: Couldn't build the PDF just now. Check your signal and try again.

evidence.images_note.en: Every photo is stored securely and shown here with its verified hash.

evidence.share_lead.en: They get one link to this record. No sign-in needed.

evidence.share_note.en: The link opens exactly what you send today, even if you add photos later. You can close it any time.

evidence.share_queued.en: No signal — this sends when you have one.

evidence.shared.en: Link created. Add their email to send it.

facility.intel_failed.en: Could not load the timing for this place.

filters.halal_hint.en: This is what each cook says about their own food. We do not check it ourselves.

filters.in_view.en: Searches the stops in view, not the whole country.

filters.none_match.en: No food in view matches what you asked for.

fleet.approvals_blocked.en: Counsel sign-off is pending, so approved claims will not be sent yet. Your decision is recorded.

fleet.none.en: You don't run a fleet yet.

fuel.be_first.en: Be the first to report the diesel price here.

ghost.facts_placeholder.en: e.g. 3 hours past free time at Dallas Receiver

handoff.broadcast_done.en: Broadcast — a nearby driver gets your spot

incident.filed.en: Filed — a protected record is open.

incident.lead.en: Log what happened — it opens a protected record.

incident.logged.en: Incident logged — added to your evidence

incident.queued.en: Saved — it'll sync when you're back online.

install.ios_step1.en: Tap Share in the bottom bar

install.why.en: Opens without signal, and it is the only way to get alerts on an iPhone.

load.appt_fix_hint.en: Use the time on the rate con. This is what your detention clock is measured against.

load.broker_email.en: Broker email — where detention notices go

load.broker_phone.en: Broker phone — who to call about this load

load.cta.warn.en: Warn broker — {minutes} min free time left

load.empty_hint.en: The Meter runs when you have a load. Add one and it starts.

load.far_body.en: Your phone puts you {mi} from {at}. If you're waiting at the gate that's normal — we'll record where you are either way.

load.geo_off.en: Location is off, so arrivals aren't detected. Start the meter yourself when you reach a dock.

load.history_empty.en: Loads you finish are kept here, with whatever they produced — the evidence pack, the paperwork, and what was owed.

load.leave_body.en: Your detention clock stops here, and the paperwork for this stop will be ready to send.

load.notice_early.en: Detention hasn't started yet — nothing to notify.

load.rc_confirm_hint.en: The load is created with these terms. You can correct them here first.

load.rc_from.en: Read from your rate con. Check it against the paper.

load.rc_here.en: Where you were when you filed this

load.rc_lead.en: Photograph the rate confirmation and we read the terms off it. Nothing is created until you confirm what we read.

load.rc_original_note.en: Quoted exactly as printed, in English. A claim is argued from the contract's own words, so these are not translated.

load.rc_place_needed.en: Add the address so arrivals at this dock are detected.

load.rc_silent.en: This rate con does not state:

load.rc_unplaced.en: We could not place this address. Check it, or use where you are now.

load.rc_unreadable.en: We could not read this one. It is saved to your wallet — enter the terms below.

load.terms.absent.en: the rate con does not say

map.basemap_failed.en: Map unavailable — the places below still work

map.basemap_no_webgl.en: This phone can't draw the map (battery saver often turns this off). The places below still work.

map.load_failed.en: Could not load the places on this map.

map.report.question_scale.en: Is this scale open right now?

map.service_none.en: No repair or service shops mapped here yet

money.act_chase.en: Write a message to chase it

money.all_paid.en: Nothing outstanding — every claim you've filed has been paid.

money.audit_cta.en: Check a settlement for missed pay

money.empty.en: Recovered and saved money shows up here. Add your first load to start the meter.

money.fee_uncollected.en: Not collected — we have no way to charge it yet.

money.load_failed.en: Could not load what you are owed.

money.paid.note.en: This records that you were paid. The money goes straight to your bank — the app never holds it.

money.paid.question.en: Which claim did the broker pay?

mpg.number.en: That needs to be a number.

mpg.range.en: Miles per gallon should be between 3 and 12.

notice.delivery.no_email.en: No broker email — add one to notify

owner.demo.en: Demo data — sign in to manage your listings.

owner.payout_note.en: Settlement activates when payments go live

packet.claim_none.en: No claim filed for this stop. File it from the load first.

packet.contents_none.en: Nothing was captured at this stop.

packet.discard_body.en: Nothing will be sent. Your photos and documents are kept — you can still find them under Past loads.

packet.empty.en: No paperwork waiting. After you leave a dock, the packet shows up here for you to check.

packet.needs_email.en: No email on file — you'll add one before this sends.

packet.note.en: Nothing goes out until you send it.

packet.offline.en: No signal. Send this when you're back online.

packet.ready.en: You left {place}. Your paperwork is ready.

packet.ready_driving.en: Paperwork ready — review it when you stop.

packet.ready_nowhere.en: You've left the dock. Your paperwork is ready.

packet.send_failed.en: Not sent — try again, or check with support if it keeps failing.

packet.waiting.en: {n} packet waiting — check before it sends

phone.ten_digits.en: A phone number needs 10 digits, area code included.

place.failed.en: Could not reach the place finder. Check your connection and try again.

place.hint.en: This only moves the map. Your location, your stop and the clock stay where you are.

portal.vendor.gaps.en: Finish these before you can publish

portal.vendor.no_access.en: This is the vendor portal. Sign in with a vendor account to manage your week.

portal.vendor.suspended.en: Publishing is paused while we review reports about you.

profile.empty.en: No driver has reported on this stop yet.

profile.sc_source.en: Hours, phone and services are this business's own words.

prompts.lot_elsewhere.en: You'll still be asked at other stops.

prompts.lot_muted.en: Muted. We won't ask about this lot again.

prompts.lot_what.en: When you park at a truck stop we'll ask how full the lot is — once a day, never while you're moving. Your answer helps the next driver find a spot.

push.what.en: Alerts reach you when the app is closed: detention started, a claim paid, a booking canceled.

push.why_denied.en: Alerts are blocked for this site. Turn them back on in your browser settings.

push.why_error.en: Could not turn alerts on. Check your connection and try again.

push.why_unconfigured.en: Alerts are not set up on this server yet.

push.why_unsupported.en: Alerts need a secure connection and a browser that supports them.

pw.err_network.en: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.

pw.err_throttled.en: Too many attempts just now. Please wait {seconds} seconds and then try again.

pw.forced_hint.en: You're signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

pw.others_out.en: Your other devices have been signed out.

qa.placeholder.en: What do you want to know?

quiet.always.en: Same start and end means no quiet hours — alerts can arrive at any time.

quiet.what.en: Quiet hours: useful-today alerts are filed here instead of interrupting you. Money and safety alerts always come through.

quiet.zone.en: Times are in {zone}, which follows your phone.

rec.broken.en: This record can't be sent: its evidence chain doesn't check out. Contact support.

rec.download.en: Save a copy to my phone

rec.empty.en: Nothing was captured on this load, so there is no record to send.

rec.no_email.en: No email on file — type where it should go.

rec.send_body.en: The broker gets a link to this record — the photos, the paperwork and the GPS trail, exactly as shown.

rec.send_offline.en: No signal. This sends when you're back online.

rec.sent.en: Sent. The broker has the link.

review.pending.en: Your review appears right away. We remove ones that break the rules.

saved.hint.en: Tapped while you were driving. Statuses aren't shown here — they were true when you tapped, not now.

score.search_hint.en: Search a receiver, shipper, or truck stop by name.

send.again_confirm.en: Send a second copy to the broker?

send.again_lead.en: They already have this. Only send again if they say it never arrived.

send.link_only.en: Link created. Add their email to send it.

sleep.load_failed.en: Could not load a sleep plan.

surface.placeholder.en: This tab arrives with its module.

system.failed.en: Not sent — still on your phone

system.load_offline.en: No connection. This loads when you have signal.

system.offline.en: Offline — everything saves to your phone

vendor.alerts_hint.en: Off by default. One a day at most, only on your route.

vendor.delivery_caps.en: Fewer than were nearby: drivers choose these alerts, and get at most one a day.

vendor.distance_direct.en: Distances are direct, not driving distance.

vendor.edit_no_resend.en: Editing updates your pin. It does not send another alert.

vendor.follow_note.en: Turns on food alerts. At most one a day, never at night.

vendor.follow_on_note.en: We will tell you when they publish near you.

vendor.gap.offering_with_price.en: Add at least one dish with a price

vendor.gap.time_window.en: Set a start and end time

vendor.halal_claim_hint.en: "Certificate on file" unlocks once you send a halal certificate and it is approved.

vendor.join.duplicate.en: A business with these details is already registered.

vendor.join.email_taken.en: That email already has an account.

vendor.join.error.en: That did not work. Check the details and try again.

vendor.join.free.en: It is free. We take no commission and sell nothing here.

vendor.join.halal_hint.en: Say plainly what you do or do not claim. "No halal claim" is a complete answer.

vendor.join.languages_hint.en: Separate with commas. Drivers filter by language.

vendor.join.starts_unverified.en: You start as Unverified, and your pin says so. Upload a licence later to move up.

vendor.join.subtitle.en: Put your food on the {brand} map.

vendor.join.to_signin.en: Already have an account? Sign in

vendor.menu_empty_hint.en: Your menu is empty. Add a dish first:

vendor.menu_snapshot_note.en: Changing a price here changes what you advertise NEXT. Anything already published keeps the price drivers were shown.

vendor.no_shows_warning.en: Drivers reported you did not show up {n} time(s) in a row. A few more pauses publishing.

vendor.none_nearby.en: No cooks on this stretch tonight.

vendor.property_approved.en: I have the property's permission to be here

vendor.property_approved_hint.en: Drivers see this. A false claim can be reported and acted on.

vendor.publish_failed.en: That did not publish. Try again.

vendor.review_policy.en: Reviews are shown as written. If one breaks the rules you can report it, and a moderator decides.

vendor.review_too_soon.en: You reviewed this cook recently. You can review again in a week.

vendor.rung_means.documents_on_file.en: Your paperwork is on file. Nobody has inspected your kitchen.

vendor.rung_means.unverified.en: You told us who you are. Nothing is checked yet.

vendor.rung_means.verified.en: Your documents were reviewed and approved.

vendor.shows_up_note.en: The same figure drivers see. Never a percentage.

vendor.site.business_name_note.en: As it appears on the building or your paperwork. We compare it with the name we hold for this site.

vendor.site.find_note.en: Search by the name the site is known by. Only places we already record as offering repair, tire, wash or parts work can be claimed.

vendor.site.food_vendor.en: Claiming a site is for fixed repair, tire and wash businesses. Your listing moves with you, so there is nothing here to claim.

vendor.site.means.approved.en: Drivers see your hours, phone and services on this site's page.

vendor.site.means.disputed.en: Another business claims this site too. An operator decides who it belongs to; neither claim is live until then.

vendor.site.means.pending.en: An operator checks claims by hand. Nothing changes on the map until one does.

vendor.site.means.rejected.en: We could not match this claim to the site. Send a licence or lease and claim it again.

vendor.site.mismatch.en: That name is not close enough to the one we hold for this site, which is:

vendor.site.mismatch_next.en: Enter the name this site trades under, or pick a different site.

vendor.site.no_results.en: Nothing matched that name. Check the spelling, or try the name on the sign rather than the legal name.

vendor.site.proof_note.en: A licence, utility bill or lease helps an operator decide. Without one they have only the name to go on, so a claim can take longer or be turned down.

vendor.site.search_error.en: Could not search just now. Try again.

vendor.site.submit_error.en: Could not send that claim. Try again.

vendor.site.taken.en: Another business has claimed this site. You can still claim it, and an operator decides who it belongs to.

vendor.site.union_note.en: Add what we are missing. What we already record stays — you cannot remove it here, and neither can we by mistake.

vendor.suggest_thanks.en: Noted — we'll look for cooks here.

vendor.upheld_note.en: reports were reviewed and upheld. Enough of these pauses publishing.

vendor.upload_note.en: Sending a document is not approval. Someone reviews it first.

voice.insecure.en: Voice needs a secure connection (https). Type your question instead.

voice.mic_blocked.en: Mic is off — type your question.

voice.net_down.en: Voice needs a connection right now. Type instead.

voice.no_mic.en: No microphone on this device — type your question.

voice.placeholder.en: Ask about parking, fuel, or what you're owed

voice.retry.en: Didn't catch that — try again or type.

voice.unavailable.en: Voice is on the Map tab for now.

voice.unsupported.en: Voice isn't available here — type your question.
